svg.title: AI AI Captain setting key study, Fjord
svg.desc: Proposal. Three redesigns of the setting keys (info keys, theme, flash intensity) compared with the current design: minimal, panel, and value first.

g.text: AI AI CAPTAIN / SETTING KEY STUDY / FJORD
Proposal. Toggle Info Keys, Cycle Theme, and Cycle Brightness now look like the INFO, PREV, and NEXT keys, and their value is hard to read.
Each style shows what the key changes and its current value. Right: the keys on a deck at 72 px, next to the navigation keys.
The layout of INFO, PREV, and NEXT.
The value is small text at the top,

g.aria-label: CODEX, CLI: WORKING, Turn in progress, Fjord

g.text: The same layout. A switch, swatches,
or a sun show the setting.

g.aria-label: CODEX, CLI: WORKING, Turn in progress, Fjord

g.text: Control colors. The value is a switch,
swatches, or a meter, with its value.
A small band names the setting.

g.aria-label: CODEX, CLI: WORKING, Turn in progress, Fjord

g.text: Canvas with a control outline, no band.
The value is large in the middle.
A new shape next to the nav keys.

g.aria-label: CODEX, CLI: WORKING, Turn in progress, Fjord

g.text: All styles use only palette tokens: the control colors, the canvas, and the state colors of the palette for the theme swatches.
The swatches show the WORKING, WAITING, DONE, and FAILED colors of the selected palette, so the key previews the palette.
The meter has one bar for each level from 1 to 4. Level 0 (palette colors) fills no bar. A switch shows ON with a filled track, and OFF with an outline. A label also shows each value.
Pushing a key does not change: Toggle Info Keys turns the info keys on or off, Cycle Theme selects the next palette, and Cycle Brightness selects the next level.
